# BorderEdges

```csharp
public enum BorderEdges
```

Namespace `SharpCell.Grid` · package `SharpCell.Grid`

Which edges of an area's cells a border goes on, as in Excel's Borders menu.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="none"></a>`None` | 0 | No edge. |
| <a id="left"></a>`Left` | 1 | The left edge of the area. |
| <a id="right"></a>`Right` | 2 | The right edge of the area. |
| <a id="top"></a>`Top` | 4 | The top edge of the area. |
| <a id="bottom"></a>`Bottom` | 8 | The bottom edge of the area. |
| <a id="outside"></a>`Outside` | 15 | Round the area: Excel's Outside Borders. |
| <a id="insidevertical"></a>`InsideVertical` | 16 | The edges between the area's columns. |
| <a id="insidehorizontal"></a>`InsideHorizontal` | 32 | The edges between the area's rows. |
| <a id="inside"></a>`Inside` | 48 | Between the cells inside the area. |
| <a id="all"></a>`All` | 63 | Every edge of every cell: Excel's All Borders. |
